scope: All 21 source stages, 2/4/8/16-vertex tree oracle and native Pauli LCU, eight-site stochastic and Chebyshev projections, both four-vertex discriminants, and both 16-vertex walks through twenty repetitions.
native_semantic_adaptations: Use the native public Pauli LCU in the original resource comparison and explicit Circuit arithmetic and coherent controls for the structured workloads. Report each native normalization and scratch cost. Reuse one native template per walk, use explicit seeded one-thousand-draw shots where the source leaves defaults, and check all full states. Display projected states after global-phase alignment as in the source.
